parameters.name: containsExternInfo
parameters.description: 返回信息中是否包含第三方信息，默认不包含。

parameters.name: externUid
parameters.description: User ID in the third-party system: if synchronized from DingTalk, this is the DingTalk employee User ID. This parameter must be used together with the provider parameter. Specifying only one of them has no effect.

parameters.name: joinTimeFrom
parameters.description: Time when the user joined the Alibaba Cloud DevOps organization, in milliseconds UNIX timestamp

parameters.name: joinTimeTo
parameters.description: Time when the user joined the Alibaba Cloud DevOps organization, in milliseconds as a UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return, ranging from 0 to 50. Default value is 20.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Starting token for paging; use the nextToken value returned from the previous request.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Third-party system (for example, DingTalk if synchronized from DingTalk). This parameter must be used together with the externUid parameter. Specifying only one of them has no effect.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Options: Normal (normal), Blocked (blocked), Deleted (deleted). Only one status can be specified. If not specified, members with Normal status are returned by default.
